clips.send: Now fill a box that is 2 by 1 and 1 over 2 by 1 with these half-size cubes: 4 times 3 times 2 equals 24 of them. 24 times 1 over 8 equals 3 , exactly what 2 times 1 and 1 over 2 times 1 gives. The formula still works!
clips.text: Now fill a box that is 2 by 1 12 by 1 with these half-size cubes: 4 times 3 times 2 equals 24 of them. 24 times 18 equals 3 , exactly what 2 times 1 12 times 1 gives. The formula still works!

clips.send: A different question: how much paper covers the box? That is the surface area, the total area of all 6 faces. Cut along some edges and lay the box flat: this flat pattern is called a net.
clips.text: A different question: how much paper covers the box? That is the surface area, the total area of all 6 faces. Cut along some edges and lay the box flat: this flat pattern is called a net.

clips.send: What if an edge is a fraction, like 1 and 1 over 2 ? Cut a unit cube in half along every edge: you get 8 small cubes with edge 1 over 2 . Each is 1 over 8 of the unit cube, and indeed 1 over 2 times 1 over 2 times 1 over 2 equals 1 over 8 .
clips.text: What if an edge is a fraction, like 1 12 ? Cut a unit cube in half along every edge: you get 8 small cubes with edge 12 . Each is 18 of the unit cube, and indeed 12 times 12 times 12 equals 18 .

clips.send: Try it: a cereal box is 8 cm wide, 3 cm deep and 12 cm tall. V equals 8 times 3 times 12 equals 288 cm cubed of cereal fits inside, and SA equals 2(24 plus 96 plus 36) equals 312 cm squared of cardboard wraps it.

clips.send: Our measuring tool is the unit cube: every edge is 1 unit long. Its volume is 1 cubic unit ( 1 unit cubed ). Volume equals how many unit cubes it takes to fill a shape.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Volume counts the cubes that FILL the inside (cubic units, cubic centimeters ); surface area counts the squares that COVER the outside (square units, square centimeters ). The two numbers can look similar, but they measure completely different things.

clips.send: 容易混淆：体积数的是“填满里面”的小正方体，单位是立方单位（ 立方厘米 ）；表面积数的是“盖住外面”的小正方形，单位是平方单位（ 平方厘米 ）。两个数字可能碰巧接近，但它们量的是完全不同的东西。
clips.text: 容易混淆：体积数的是“填满里面”的小正方体，单位是立方单位（cm³）；表面积数的是“盖住外面”的小正方形，单位是平方单位（cm²）。两个数字可能碰巧接近，但它们量的是完全不同的东西。

clips.send: 用这种小正方体去填满一个长 2 、宽 1又 2分之1 、高 1 的长方体：一共需要 4 乘 3 乘 2 等于 24 个。 24 乘 8分之1 等于 3 ，和 2 乘 1又 2分之1 乘 1 算出来的完全一样。公式照样成立！
clips.text: 用这种小正方体去填满一个长 2 、宽 1 12 、高 1 的长方体：一共需要 4 乘 3 乘 2 等于 24 个。 24 乘 18 等于 3 ，和 2 乘 1 12 乘 1 算出来的完全一样。公式照样成立！

clips.send: 这把“尺子”就是单位正方体：每条棱长都是 1 个单位，它的体积是 1 立方单位。体积就是：需要多少个单位正方体才能把物体填满。
clips.text: 这把“尺子”就是单位正方体：每条棱长都是 1 个单位，它的体积是 1 立方单位。体积就是：需要多少个单位正方体才能把物体填满。

clips.send: 如果棱长是分数，比如 1又 2分之1 ，怎么办？把单位正方体的每条棱都对半切开，得到 8 个棱长为 2分之1 的小正方体。每个都是单位正方体的 8分之1 ，而 2分之1 乘 2分之1 乘 2分之1 恰好等于 8分之1 。
clips.text: 如果棱长是分数，比如 1 12 ，怎么办？把单位正方体的每条棱都对半切开，得到 8 个棱长为 12 的小正方体。每个都是单位正方体的 18 ，而 12 乘 12 乘 12 恰好等于 18 。
